# Is your overtime paid on the right rate?

> Free FLSA regular rate of pay and overtime audit for restaurants, retailers, staffing agencies and bookkeepers. Paste payroll rows, see the regular rate with bonuses and shift differentials, the half-time premium owed, back pay and lookback exposure. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
